Welcome to Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg
Study. Conduct research. Create. With more than 50 degree programs, we offer you the best start to your academic journey in the heart of Bavaria. At Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg, we combine knowledge, practical experience, and innovation. Together, we shape the world—through modern degree programs, exciting projects, and close collaboration with companies and research partners.

Good Reasons to Study at THA
Why study at the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg? Because it’s where practical experience, knowledge, and community come together. Here, you’ll benefit from modern degree programs, personalized support, and exciting projects that will prepare you perfectly for your future.
Wide Range of Subjects
Our degree programs cover the fields of engineering, business, design, and social sciences.
Practical Degree Program
With us, you won't just learn theory—you'll also work on projects with direct real-world applications.
A Focus on Research and Teaching
We focus on topics that are shaping the world, such as artificial intelligence and sustainability.
Vibrant Campus Life
There's always something going on here—lots of student-led initiatives and activities are waiting for you to get involved.
Strong  Network
We maintain close relationships with partners from the business community and civil society.
A Vibrant Entrepreneurial Spirit
Do you have an exciting idea? As Germany's top university for startups, we'll help you bring it to life.
Central location in Augsburg
Our campus is located right in the heart of the city and is well connected to public transportation.
Making a Difference Together
Here, people from different cultures and with different backgrounds come together and learn from and with one another.

10/01/2026 • News
2,600 students are starting the 2026/207 winter semester
More than 2,600 young people began a bachelor’s, master’s, or orientation program today at the Augsburg University of Applied Sciences (THA). The first students in the bachelor’s programs in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics as well as Medical Technology have also started their studies. As a result, approximately 8,000 students will be enrolled at THA for the first time in the winter semester of 2026/2027.

09/22/2026 • News
THA Welcomes International Students
During the 2026/2027 winter semester, nearly 100 international students will spend a semester abroad at THA. They come from Argentina, Belgium, China, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Jordan, Mexico, the Netherlands, Northern Ireland, Portugal, Romania, Switzerland, Slovakia, Spain, South Korea, Taiwan, Turkey, and Ukraine. Once again this year, the International Office, together with the SWOP team, the faculties, and several support services, has organized the Welcome Week before the official start of the semester: The goal is to help newcomers settle in Augsburg and at THA, connect them with one another, and introduce them to various support services.

08/18/2026 • News
THA Heads to Gamescom 2026
From culinary island worlds to a defensive dragonfly, surreal puzzles, and a cooperative space mission: The Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg (THA) is presenting four games developed by students at Gamescom 2026 in Cologne. The projects “Flavour Fare,” “Odonata Augmenta: Rogue Dragonfly,” “Inkorus,” and “They Sent Us Both” will be on display from August 26 to 30 at the RAW TALENT joint booth in Hall 10.2, Booth E-42, at Koelnmesse.

07/30/2026 • News
THA and Hessing Launch Educational Partnership for Bachelor Program in Medical Technology
The Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg (THA) and the Hessing Foundation have agreed to a long-term educational partnership for the new bachelor program in Medical Technology. Starting in the winter semester of 2026/2027, the Hessing Foundation will contribute its medical and clinical expertise to the students’ education. The THA is responsible for the engineering content, its integration into the curriculum, and academic quality assurance.

07/08/2026 • News
Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg Elects New Vice-Presidium
Prof. Dr. Frank Danzinger, Professor of Digital Business, Prof. Dr. Eva Lermer-Spitzweg, Research Professor in Business Psychology; Prof. Dr. Martina Königbauer, Professor of Systematic Product Development; and Prof. Dr. László Kovács, Professor of Ethics and Politics, make up the new Vice-Presidium of the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg. They were unanimously elected to their positions yesterday, Tuesday, July 7, 2026, by the University Council of the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg. Together with President Prof. Dr. Gordon Thomas Rohrmair and Chancellor Sandra Scholl, they will form the Executive Board of the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg effective October 1, 2026.

06/19/2026 • News
A Flurry of Medals at the ADC Talent Award
Top Results: THA Designers win eleven Nails and nine Awards: Students and graduates of the bachelor programs in Communication Design and Interactive Media at the Faculty of Design at the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg received a total of eleven “Nails” and nine awards for their coursework and theses at the Art Directors Club Germany’s ADC Talent Award 2026. With this outstanding result, THA is the second-most-awarded university in the competition.

05/20/2026 • News
Cyberstark: THA Professor of IT Security Calls for a More Positive Approach to Cybersecurity Through a Music Video
Dominik Merli, professor of IT security at the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg (THA), is convinced: “Cybersecurity has to get into everyone’s head—even if it’s just as a catchy tune.” Following his 2025 security parody of “Gangsta’s Paradise,” he is now releasing his original creation, “Cyberstark.” The music video kicks off an awareness and information campaign on the topic of people and cybersecurity.

05/15/2026 • News
How can Scottish wind energy be stored as hydrogen?
UniA and THA sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the University of the Highlands and Islands in Inverness. Further research into resilient hydrogen-based energy systems is the goal of a cooperation project that the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg and the University of the Highlands and Islands in Inverness, Scotland (UHI) have signed. The universities aim to deepen their existing scientific collaboration. On May 11, they signed a Memorandum of Understanding to this end.

Innovations at the Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg (THA) arise from research. One of the THA’s core competencies is the transfer of research findings into practical applications. In doing so, it benefits from its strong network of regional and national partners from business, society, and academia.
